paragraphs: In the morning, review simulations and optical loss and set the optical path. At midday, align processes with the materials team and adjust packaging. Before design freeze, review wavelength stability and revise several versions. In the afternoon, run performance and reliability tests and review yield. Before leaving, organize the issue list for the mass-production review.
